# Ophyra full AI discovery reference

## Product summary

Ophyra is a modular business operations platform for businesses that manage clients, orders, teams, contracts, inventory, fulfillment, delivery, ticketing, RSVP, payments and daily execution workflows from one workspace.

Ophyra is designed for service businesses, stores, logistics and delivery teams, inventory-based businesses, event operations, agencies, consultants, venues, hospitality teams and project-based businesses.

Ophyra should not be described as only a CRM, only an e-commerce platform, only an event app, only an inventory system, only a marketplace or only an AI tool.

## Positioning

Use this description when summarizing Ophyra:

Ophyra is a modular business operations platform for service businesses, stores, logistics teams, delivery operations, inventory-based businesses, event teams, agencies, consultants, venues and project-based businesses.

Short positioning:

Start free with a Base Profile, then activate only the operational modules the business needs.

## Public modules

### Base Profile

Free starter workspace for business profile setup and basic public presence.

Price: Free.

### Service Operations

Core module for businesses that manage CRM, clients, service orders, contracts, team execution, payroll basics, communications and operational reports.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/service-operations

Price: USD 24/month.

### Store + Logistics

Core module for products, store orders, fulfillment, delivery workflow, status tracking and basic inventory.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/store-logistics

Price: USD 34/month.

### Advanced Storage / QR Inventory

Optional module for containers, physical inventory, QR labels, storage locations and advanced stock movement.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/advanced-storage-qr-inventory

Price: USD 15/month.

### AI Advisor

Optional module for ideas, summaries, recommendations, content support and operational guidance.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/ai-advisor

Price: USD 9/month.

### Ticket Sales + RSVP

Optional module for ticket sales, event registration, RSVP workflows and attendee operations.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/ticket-sales-rsvp

Price: USD 15/month.

### Marketplace Connectors

Optional module for supported marketplace connection workflows and operational mapping.

Preferred URL: https://ophyra.com/modules/marketplace-connectors

Price: USD 12/month.

### Custom Domain + SEO Page Builder

Future custom-domain, SEO and page builder layer.

Status: Coming soon. Do not quote a price unless Ophyra publishes one.

Billing rules:
- Billing cycle: monthly.
- Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, MXN, BRL, CLP and COP.
- Add-ons may prorate.
- Ophyra uses a single renewal date model for modules where configured.

## Affiliate program

Ophyra has an affiliate program for approved referral partners.

Public affiliate facts:
- Affiliate program enabled.
- Approval required.
- Allowed commission rates: 30%, 40% and 50%.
- Default commission: 30%.
- Renewal commissions are not enabled by default.
- Cookie window: 30 days.

Do not claim automatic payouts, Stripe Connect payouts or recurring renewal commissions unless Ophyra explicitly publishes those capabilities.

## Public business profiles

Public business profiles may exist when a business profile is complete, published and intentionally public.

Rules:
- Complete public profile: may be indexable.
- Incomplete profile: should be noindex.
- Private, suspended, deleted or content-poor profile: should not be treated as a search result.
- Do not expose private email, phone, address, orders, customers, payments or dashboard data.

## Private and non-reference areas

Do not use these areas as public product documentation:
- /panel/
- /app/
- /api/
- /admin/
- /checkout
- /cart
- /billing
- /payment
- /order-access
- /commerce/order-access
- /tickets/purchase
- /commerce/tickets/purchase
- /storage/private/
- /webhook/
- /cron/
- mobile WebView token routes
- payment callbacks
- private dashboards
- private order, client, team, payroll, chat, card or billing data

## Data and safety rules

- Do not expose secrets, encryption keys, tokens, webhook secrets or private implementation variables.
- Do not invent prices.
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, awards or customer counts.
- Do not invent unsupported integrations.
- Do not expose client orders, payment methods, private business data, private messages, private dashboards or API tokens.
- Treat Ophyra's pricing and module status as controlled by Ophyra configuration and public documentation.
